info.summary: Community scores for games, movies, TV series and books.
info.description:
Read-only REST API over the {brand} catalog: every item carries a 0–100 community score and six per-category averages.

- **Auth**: `Authorization: Bearer hx_live_…` — create a key at `/profile/api`.
- **Format**: JSON, `snake_case` fields, ISO 8601 dates. Errors are RFC 9457 `application/problem+json` with a stable `code`.
- **Pagination**: cursor based — pass `next_cursor` back as `cursor`.
- **Plans**: Free = {freeQuota} requests in total, {freePageSize} items per page, {freeRps} req/s. Pro and Business have monthly quotas, {paidPageSize} items per page and prepaid credits.

Guides: {docsUrl}

tags.search: Find items by text or by an id from another database.
tags.account: Your quota, credits and rate limit.

listGames.description: Pages through games with filters. Categories for this type: {categories} — filter with `min_<category>`. Pass `next_cursor` back as `cursor` until it is `null`.

getGame.description: Full record: metadata, community score and per-category averages ({categories}), external ids, trailers and the licensed synopsis. An id of another type returns 404.

listGameGenres.description: Every genre used by this type with its item count. Use `slug` as the `genre` filter.

searchItems.description: Typo-tolerant search over titles and synopses in every locale, best match first (up to {max} results).

lookupItem.description: Finds the item for an IMDb, Steam, IGDB, TMDB, ISBN-13, Open Library or Wikidata id. Ids must match exactly (e.g. `tt0111161`, `Q42`).

getUsage.description: Plan, quota used in the current period, prepaid credits and rate limit. Counts as one request.

headers.rateLimitLimit: Requests in the current quota period.
headers.rateLimitReset: Seconds until the quota resets (`0` for the lifetime Free quota).
headers.requestId: Id of this request; quote it to support.

errors.bad_request: Invalid query parameter, cursor, or a `limit` above your plan's page size.
errors.unauthorized: Missing, malformed, unknown or revoked API key.
errors.payment_required: Quota (and credits, on paid plans) exhausted. Upgrade or buy credits.
errors.forbidden: The account that owns the key is suspended.
errors.not_found: No such item, type or route.
errors.rate_limited: Too many requests per second. Wait `Retry-After` seconds.
errors.internal_error: Unexpected error. The request was not counted against your quota.

security.bearerAuth: API key from /profile/api, sent as `Authorization: Bearer hx_live_…`.

schemas.itemType: Kind of item. List endpoints use the plural path (`/games`, `/movies`, `/series`, `/books`).

ItemSummary._: Compact item used in lists and search results.
ItemSummary.title: Title in the requested locale, English when missing.
ItemSummary.score: Community score 0–100 (mean of the six categories). `null` until the item has 5 ratings.
ItemSummary.categories: Average per category, 0–100, `null` under 5 ratings. Keys by type — {categories}.
ItemSummary.platforms: Platforms (games only; empty for other types).
ItemSummary.url: Public page of the item on the website, in the requested locale.

Synopsis._: Synopsis with the license you must honour when showing it.
Synopsis.locale: Locale the text is written in.
Synopsis.license: License of the text (e.g. `CC BY-SA 4.0`). Attribute it when you display the synopsis.
Synopsis.source_url: Where the text comes from (for attribution).

ExternalIds._: Identifiers of the item in other databases. Only known ids are present.

TimeToBeatStat.median_hours: Median hours reported by players who completed the game (1 decimal). `null` under {minReports} reports.
TimeToBeatStat.reports: Number of players who reported this style.

TimeToBeat._: Crowdsourced time to beat per play style: main story, main + extras, completionist.

ItemDetail._: Full item: metadata, scores, external ids, trailers and synopsis.
ItemDetail.translation_fallback: True when the requested locale had no title or synopsis and English was used.

ItemList.next_cursor: Pass as `cursor` to get the next page. `null` on the last page.

SearchResult._: Best matches first. Search is not paginated.

GenreList._: Genres of a type, most common first.
GenreList.count: Items of this type with the genre.

Usage._: Quota, credits and rate limit of the key's account. This call counts as one request.
Usage.period: `lifetime` on Free (100 requests in total); `month` on paid plans (UTC calendar month).
Usage.balance: Prepaid requests used after the quota runs out (paid plans).

Problem.type: Link to the documentation of this error.
Problem.detail: What went wrong and how to fix it.

query.genre: Exact genre, as returned by the genres endpoint.
query.sort: Sort field; prefix with `-` for descending. Unscored/undated items always come last.
query.limit: Page size, 1–{upTo}. Free plan: up to 10.
query.locale: Language of titles and synopses (`en`, `pt-BR`, `es`). Falls back to English.
